items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1959-06-02
items.q: The interviewee does not respond to the mention of Peter Firenette; the name is only introduced by Speaker_03.

ctx.x: Two at a time. That's when it was, and the most we played then was Marilyn and Naga Rain the Moor. So dry that scene, you know. So Celestine and I went up together. Then the saxophone and banjo went up together. Then the saxophone and banjo and the clarinet went up together. The bass couldn't be. The rinfo piece.
Was that when you had Sam Dutre with you? Did he go and have Peter Firenette to wind up? Right.
Did Sam Dutre play up in the plane? Did he go up and was he in the band then?
